papers.title_en: LEGAU: Learning Semantic Gaussian Priors for Scalable Category-level Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Hongli Xu, Zhaowei Lu, Junwen Huang, Jiaqi Hu, Peter KT Yu, Benjamin Busam, Federico Tombari, Slobodan ilic
papers.evidence: 利用语义高斯场与文本嵌入进行多模态特征融合
papers.tldr: 针对单张RGB-D进行类别级6D位姿估计时，部分可见几何与规范物体结构需共同解释，问题本质欠约束。LEGAU提出统一框架，联合预测NOCS对应、物体位姿尺寸及规范语义高斯场，并将高斯场作为类别条件结构先验参与多模态特征融合，为局部位姿推理提供全局引导。方法以类别文本嵌入为条件，通过Transformer融合RGB-D的视觉、几何与类别线索。在合成与真实基准上，单模型多类别设置取得强性能，SOPE最高提升22%，真实数据迁移具竞争力，证明联合学习对应、形状与位姿对齐的统一表示有效。
papers.abstract_en: Category-level 6D pose estimation from a single RGB-D observation is inherently under-constrained, since partial visible geometry must be interpreted together with a canonical object structure before a stable pose can be determined. We present LEGAU, a unified framework that jointly predicts NOCS correspondence, object pose and size, and a canonical Semantic Gaussian Field. Rather than treating reconstruction as a detached auxiliary task, LEGAU uses the Gaussian field as a category-conditioned structural prior that participates in multimodal feature fusion and provides global guidance for local pose reasoning. Conditioned on a categorical text embedding, LEGAU processes RGB-D observations through a transformer-based fusion module that integrates visual, geometric, and category-level cues, decoding the NOCS map, pose and size information and the Gaussian-based object representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that this coupled pose-shape formulation achieves strong performance in a single-model multi-category setting, with up to 22\% on SOPE and competitive transfer to real-world data. These results highlight the benefit of jointly learning canonical correspondence, object shape, and pose alignment within a unified representation.
